Presenting The Official Video Song of "1234 Shille Hodi" from "Anjaniputhraa"; Starring Puneeth Rajkumar & Rashmika Mandanna on lead. Hariprriya has made a special appearance for this song. The Movie is Directed by A. Harsha. Music Composed by Ravi Basrur.
Track : 1234 Shille Hodi
Singers : Puneeth Rajkumar, Chandan Shetty
Lyricist : V. Nagendra Prasad
Cast : Puneeth Rajkumar, Rashmika Mandanna, Ramya Krishnan
Director : A. Harsha
Music Director : Ravi Basrur
Cinematography : Swamy J
